scripts.check: node build.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.66 check wide && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.66 check reel
scripts.snapshot: npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.66 snapshot wide --at 0.3,0.9,1.5,2.4,3.4 && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.66 snapshot reel --at 0.3,0.9,1.5,2.4,3.4
scripts.render: node build.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.66 render wide -o ../public/sting-wide.mp4 --fps 60 --quality delivery && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.66 render reel -o ../public/sting-reel.mp4 --fps 60 --quality delivery
